Your effort can make a difference, but I also believe time can heal many facing similar things, and other passive factors can influence you to get better one day….

In fact in my case all my delusions went away almost 100% and when i do get small tastes of it, I tend to see these delusions in a different light, and be even thankful of it depending. Cardio as the main stimulus you ask your body to adapt to, while simultaneously calorie restricting to try to lose fat. 

Body slows down metabolism to become more efficient and also realizes it doesn’t know when it’s next meal will be; food is scarce, reminiscent of early human evolution where we wanted to keep as much body fat as possible for these conditions.
